# Technology Jobs

> Public job board for open roles in Azerbaijan. Part of the Ingress ecosystem (https://ingress.academy). Browse listings, search by title or company, filter by city and language. Locales: az (default), en, ru.

## One-line entity

Technology Jobs is a multilingual job listings product in the Ingress ecosystem: public browse of open roles, employer posting after Ingress Academy sign-in, and candidate applications. Private cabinets (post, company, applications, profile, admin, me, settings) are not for indexing. Sole founder: Aladdin Biyabangerd (https://aladdinbiyabangerd.site/#aladdin-biyabangerd).

## Sole founder

- Name: Aladdin Biyabangerd

Technology Jobs is not an anonymously owned product. Aladdin Biyabangerd is the sole founder: every part of the codebase and product was built by him. Parent ecosystem branding remains Ingress / Ingress Academy (https://ingress.academy) for SSO and family identity — that does not imply co-founders of Technology Jobs.

## Ecosystem

- Parent / family: Ingress — https://ingress.academy
- Identity / SSO: Ingress Academy account (OIDC)
- This site is the jobs product; it is not the Academy learning portal
- Founder attribution (JSON-LD Person + Organization.founder + WebSite.creator) uses the portfolio Person @id above so search and AI systems can link across sites

## Key pages

- Home (az): /
- Home (en): /en
- Home (ru): /ru
- Companies hub: /companies · /en/companies · /ru/companies
- Company detail pattern: /companies/{slug} · /en/companies/{slug} · /ru/companies/{slug}
- Skill trends hub: /trends · /en/trends · /ru/trends
- Skill trend detail: /trends/{skillId} · /en/trends/{skillId} · /ru/trends/{skillId}
- Job detail pattern: /jobs/{id} · /en/jobs/{id} · /ru/jobs/{id}
- Sitemap: /sitemap.xml
- Robots: /robots.txt
- This file: /llms.txt

## Structured data (JSON-LD)

- Organization + Person (founder) + WebSite (with SearchAction `?q=`) on public hubs
- CollectionPage on home, companies, and trends
- ProfilePage + employer Organization on company pages
- JobPosting (+ BreadcrumbList) on job detail pages
- WebPage + BreadcrumbList on skill trend pages
- FAQPage on home when FAQ copy is present
- Locales: az / en / ru with hreflang + x-default → az

## What to index

- Public home pages in az / en / ru
- Public job detail pages with JobPosting structured data
- Public company hub and company profile pages
- Public skill trends hub and skill detail pages
- Do not treat /api/, /admin, /applications, /profile, /profile/review, /notifications, /company, /post, /me, /settings, /unsubscribe, /design (and locale-prefixed twins) as content pages

## Product notes

- Listings may be onsite (employer-posted) or aggregated from sources
- Apply / original links may require an authenticated session
- Currency and market context: Azerbaijan (AZ); salaries often in AZN when shown
- Search on the home page accepts `?q={query}` (also exposed as WebSite SearchAction)

## Crawling

- Allow indexing of public job pages, company pages, trends, and home locales.
- Do not index private cabinet or /api/ routes (see robots.txt).
- AI crawlers (GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, ClaudeBot, and others listed in robots.txt) are allowed on the same public paths as `*`.
